Maximum-offset rejection uses five physical rows, inline IDs and uniform created/latest1; offsets{0,100} have valid cardinality2 but exceed the row bound. RewriteColumns build must fail with max offset substring; no Error variant asserted. Complements cardinality rejection without conflating the two checks.

Exact-boundary test uses the same five-row fixture with offsets0..5 (0 through4). RewriteColumns build is expected to succeed; it does not inspect the resulting per-row version values. The boundary is maximum offset4, not an inclusive offset5.

Offsets-key validation constructs manifest fragments1/2, updated list containing1 only and offset map keyed2. Calls validate_operation directly and requires not in updated_fragments text. Does not invoke builder; fixture's single inline ID versus physical_rows5 is incidental and not validated by this assertion. Pins API validation of target membership before unrelated lineage can be stamped.

Protobuf offset roundtrip makes Update with bitmap map1->{1,3,5},2->{0,2,4,6}, no updated fragments. Encoding must leave legacy field9 vector-map empty and populate field10 bitmap-map with two entries. Decode must preserve both Roaring bitmaps exactly. Object conversion only; does not call operation validation, wire encode/decode or historical released fixture.

Legacy field9-read test constructs current protobuf Transaction with only UInt32List{1,3,5} for fragment1 and empty field10. Decode must produce one bitmap yielding those ordered offsets. Its comment calls this a manifest but actual object is pb::Transaction; no historical file is loaded.

Field10 precedence fixture serializes bitmap{10,20,30}, supplies conflicting legacy list{99,100} for same fragment1 and decodes current pb::Transaction. Result must yield field10 values exactly. Tests both-fields/same-key priority, not per-key merge when maps have disjoint keys or malformed bitmap fallback.

Stable-ID Merge changed-files test swaps before.lance to after.lance for same ID0, five inline IDs and missing prior lineage; reader stable flag set and next_row_id100. Build candidate version2 must provide latest version2 at first/last rows. Does not assert created metadata, all rows, or actual file contents.

Stable-ID Merge carry-forward fixture has unchanged same.lance, same row IDs, five physical rows and uniform latest1. Build preserves latest1 at first/last offsets; checks no blanket refresh for unchanged data files. Created metadata remains unasserted.

Nonstable Merge fixture explicitly asserts no stable reader flag, then swaps before/after file for five-row fragment without IDs/lineage. Build must leave latest metadata None. Uses stable-resolved file format but table stable-row-ID feature is disabled, distinguishing file version from row identity mode.

New-ID Merge setup has stable reader flag, manifest version1, existing fragment0 with three IDs and new fragment1 with four IDs absent from prior manifest. Both begin without created/latest metadata; next_row_id100 and stable-resolved files are metadata fixtures.

New-ID Merge supplies both fragments and builds version2. Find ID1 and require created and latest metadata, both first/last rows at2. Establishes two lineage fields for a new fragment ID, not assignment of new row IDs or rewriting existing fragment0 lineage.

DataOverlay multi-fragment test starts currentversion3: target0 already has overlay@3, target1 empty, untargeted2 overlay@3. Add overlays to0/1; candidateversion increases, existing0@3 stays before newly stamped overlay,1 gets stamped overlay,2 keeps original@3. Assertions count/order/versions, not on-disk overlay decoding or selected values.

Overlay-lineage setup: fragment1 four rows with uniform created/latest1 and IDs10..13; fragment2 two rows with IDs20/21 and no lineage, representing migrated rows whose documented scan default is1. make_stable_row_id_manifest produces currentversion4; no scan is run here.

DataOverlay applies dense row{0} plus sparse field bitmaps{2}/{3} to fragment1, dense{1} to fragment2. Build must yield latest[5,1,5,5] and[1,5], unioning all overlay coverage and initializing absent lineage with baseline1. It asserts every overlay on first result fragment stamped to candidateversion; second fragment stamps/created fields are not directly asserted.

DataReplacement overlay tombstone test replaces legacy basefield5 exactly, alongside basefield3 and old overlay[3,5]/overlay[5] at readversion1. Candidate must contain f5-new.lance, drop all-field5 overlay and retain one overlay with raw fields[3,-2]. No row data decode; legacy partial-overlay metadata tombstoning differs from forbidden partial legacy base-file replacement.

replace_fields helper builds nullable Int32 schema with explicit IDs3/4/5/6, one supplied fragment and selected currentversion. Stages V2_0 v-new.lance replacement for fragment0 with ordinal column indices at caller readversion, runs builder and returns cloned first result fragment. A missing/empty output would panic via indexing; helper does no IO.
replace_field_5 is a private test convenience fixing replaced fields to[5], forwarding fragment/current/read versions to replace_fields. It does not alter conflict or format behavior.

Legacy subset rejection fixture base[4,5] uses legacy format, stages V2 replacement of5 and requires error without asserting variant/message. Comment explains V1 page-table offset depends on first field and tombstoning a sibling can corrupt decoding; test does not read V1 pages.

Spanning V2 replacement starts ab[3,4] and cd[5,6], replaces[4,5]. Both old files survive with respectively[3,-2] and[-2,6], and new v-new.lance must exist. Tests multi-file tombstone-and-append, but not physical-row consistency or byte values.

Mixed-format spanning replacement uses V2 ab[3,4] and legacy cd[5,6], replaces[4,5] and requires failure. Error variant/message and external mutation rollback are not asserted; builder operates on local candidate clones.
Repeated tombstoning fixture V2 wide[4,-2,5] replaces5, expecting retained wide[4,-2,-2] plus new file. Existing tombstone positions and column layout remain; no physical rewrite of old file.

Newer-overlay preservation: V2 base[4,5], overlayfield5 committed7, transaction read6 against manifest7. Replacing5 follows partial-base path and must keep new base plus overlayfields[5]. Tests candidate recency semantics only; comment references conflict rebase but resolver is not invoked here.

Project hidden-carrier setup has four physical rows, row-ID Column and created Column; d.lance holds schemafields0/1, l.lance holds reserved row-ID/created fields, both V2_0. Schemaa/b and paired stable flags make hidden lineage necessary despite absence from schema IDs.

Project drops schemafield1, then asserts paths remain[d.lance,l.lance] and row_lineage_file for row-ID/created resolves l.lance. It preserves wider base files by intersection; does not assert rewriting raw data field lists, latest carrier or reading column bytes.

Two DataReplacement hidden-carrier parameter cases: standalone l.lance row-ID carrier next to wide3/4/5/6, replacing3/4 leaves wide[-2,-2,5,6]; in-file carrier wide3/4/5/6/rowID replacing all userfields leaves four tombstones plus rowID. Expected ordered files include appended v-new.lance and original carrier.

Carrier test builds V2 files with ordinal column indices and row-ID Column, runs replace_fields, asserts exact ordered(path,fields) vector and row_lineage_file resolves expected carrier. Covers metadata survival for two layouts, not hidden value contents or created/latest Column forms.

Two missing-carrier cases Merge row-ID Column with V2 field0 only or V1[0,rowID]. Builder must fail Error::Internal with fragment0 and reserved row-ID in message. Empty column_indices are deliberate; tests carrier IDs/version, not column-index validity or actual file schema.

Duplicate DataOverlay groups both target fragment0 with fields1 then2. Build must retain two overlays in input order with corresponding fields. Prevents last-group-wins HashMap collapse; version stamping tested elsewhere.
Unknown-fragment overlay targets99 in samplemanifest. build_manifest error must contain does not exist. No error variant asserted; empty-group unknown-target case is not tested here.

Nullability assertion codec test loops false/true for current pb::Project and pb::Merge, requiring decoded preserves_nullability exactly equal supplied bool. Comments connect default false to conservative legacy conflict behavior, but test invokes no resolver, absent historical wire message or builder; it validates current object mapping only.
